conversion.exporter: export.export_rfdetr.export (rfdetr RFDETRSmall.export -> torch.onnx.export; graph producer pytorch 2.6.0)

notes: Serving artifact. dregsbane-web-backend/src/lib/inference/session.ts loads it from MODEL_S3_URI with the sidecar next to it; its ModelMeta interface has no precision field, so nothing on the serving side checks that these bytes are fp32. This record is the only place that binding is written down.
sourceCheckpointSha256 is null because the training checkpoint was never hashed. Provenance stops at the ONNX; the .pth is not on this disk and no receipt records its digest.

targetRuntimeVersion is the semver range from dregsbane-web-backend/package.json (onnxruntime-node ^1.27.0). The version actually resolved at deploy time is not recorded anywhere, so this record cannot state it.

parity role=reference: this artifact was side a of the fp32-vs-fp16 comparison, and is also side a of reports/parity-rfdetr-v2.0.1-fp32-vs-int8-dyn.json. Being a baseline licenses nothing about its own fidelity to the checkpoint it was exported from; no such measurement exists.

measuredOnTarget is false: the parity evidence was gathered by Python onnxruntime 1.29.0 on a macOS arm64 workstation, and this artifact serves under onnxruntime-node on arm64 Lambda. The divergence numbers are evidence about the conversion, not about the deployment.
